# ignifx.audiobuses

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:schemas`. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Audio buses file (`ignifx/audiobuses-file`)

The project's mixer tree: named buses, each routed into a bus declared before it. The first entry is the root.

| Field | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `str` | `"ignifx.audiobuses"` | Always "ignifx.audiobuses". |
| `formatVersion` | `u32` | `1` | The file format version; 1 before ignifx 1.0. |
| `buses` | `array` | `[]` | The buses, parents before children; the first entry is the root. |
| `buses[].name` | `str` | `""` | The bus name game code routes by, for example "SFX". |
| `buses[].parent` | `str` | `""` | The bus this one outputs into; empty for the root. |
| `buses[].volume` | `f32` | `1` | The bus's own linear gain, 0 to 1. |
| `buses[].pausable` | `bool` | `null` | Whether app.pause() pauses this bus; omitted defers to audio.pausableBuses. |
